name: prediction_markets (kyleyhw)
what_it_holds: Scripts analyzing Polymarket/Kalshi market microstructure (bid-ask spreads, arbitrage detection) and explicitly verifying historical data integrity via CLOB and Gamma APIs.
why_useful: The data-integrity verification code is a useful template for point-in-time correctness checks (rule 2 of our own project) when pulling prediction-market vintages, even though the repo itself stores no dataset.
themes: Prediction markets and betting data: Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold APIs and datasets on earnings and travel/regulation events
why_all: The data-integrity verification code is a useful template for point-in-time correctness checks (rule 2 of our own project) when pulling prediction-market vintages, even though the repo itself stores no dataset.

name: Futuur-Kalshi-Polymarket-API-data-Automation
what_it_holds: Client-commissioned project retrieving ongoing-event data from Futuur, Kalshi, and Polymarket APIs and matching equivalent markets across platforms by title.
why_useful: Same cross-platform matching value as futuur/prediction_markets; a second independent implementation to sanity-check the matching approach if we ever build an event-probability panel.
themes: Prediction markets and betting data: Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold APIs and datasets on earnings and travel/regulation events
why_all: Same cross-platform matching value as futuur/prediction_markets; a second independent implementation to sanity-check the matching approach if we ever build an event-probability panel.

name: prediction-markets-skill
what_it_holds: A 'Claude skill' packaging read-only Kalshi + Polymarket market-data retrieval with zero dependencies and no API keys required, meant to stop AI agents from hallucinating prediction-market API calls.
why_useful: Directly reusable as a no-key, no-dependency method for our own agents to pull live Kalshi/Polymarket prices on any ABNB-earnings, FIFA World Cup, or regulation-outcome market if we decide to build a live panel.
themes: Prediction markets and betting data: Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold APIs and datasets on earnings and travel/regulation events
why_all: Directly reusable as a no-key, no-dependency method for our own agents to pull live Kalshi/Polymarket prices on any ABNB-earnings, FIFA World Cup, or regulation-outcome market if we decide to build a live panel.

name: polymarket-tennis
what_it_holds: MIT, observe-only toolkit that discovers Polymarket sports markets via the Gamma API and matches them to live match data to watch market price vs. live score/server/break-point in real time.
why_useful: Not travel/ABNB-relevant directly, but it is the most-starred (317) worked example of pattern-matching a specific event-market category on Polymarket's Gamma API by topic — a reusable template if we later want to isolate ABNB-earnings or World-Cup-timing markets the same way.
themes: Prediction markets and betting data: Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold APIs and datasets on earnings and travel/regulation events

name: sports-skills
what_it_holds: Open-source agent skills (SKILL.md format) for live sports data and prediction markets covering football, F1, Kalshi, and Polymarket, with zero API keys required.
why_useful: Marginal for ABNB directly (sports-focused), but demonstrates a no-key pattern for pulling Kalshi/Polymarket data that could be adapted to non-sports event categories (regulation, macro) relevant to gap 11/12.
